purpose: Two fixed Poisson R6 fastMRI-brain slices for a compact visual demonstration.
data_scope: Derived RSS images and mask only; no raw multi-coil k-space is redistributed here.
visual_bundle_note: The compact arrays are frozen visual snapshots for the two fixed examples. They are rendered by render_poisson_demo.py and are not raw multi-coil inputs for the reconstruction runner.
reconstruction_entrypoint_note: The reconstruction runner requires an external carrier NPZ containing kspace and mask; raw multi-coil fastMRI carriers are not redistributed in this compact demo.
metric_scope: center-square ROI; primary SSIM is the foreground ROI SSIM from the release metric implementation
selection_policy: Two fixed slice-008 examples for representative qualitative display; descriptive only, not a population-level estimate.
